$comment: dfw hooks for GitHub Copilot. PascalCase events use the Claude/VS Code compatible payload (snake_case fields, Claude tool names: create->Write, edit->Edit), which the binary normalizes (native/src/core/host.rs). Copilot ignores additionalContext on UserPromptSubmit, so new Studio comments are delivered on PostToolUse and Stop.

SessionStart.bash: R="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}/installed-plugins/dfw-marketplace/dfw}}"; for B in "$R/bin/dfw" "$HOME/.local/bin/dfw"; do [ -x "$B" ] && exec "$B" hook session-start --host copilot; done; exec dfw hook session-start --host copilot
SessionStart.powershell: $h = if ($env:COPILOT_HOME) { $env:COPILOT_HOME } else { "$HOME\.copilot" }; $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } else { "$h\installed-plugins\dfw-marketplace\dfw" }; if (Get-Command dfw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { dfw hook session-start --host copilot } else { & "$r\bin\dfw.cmd" hook session-start --host copilot }
